confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and supplied context, not from live booking pages or current menus. Restaurant and café anchors are the most reliable. Cocktail and wine are less certain and are set relative to the beer anchor, since direct knowledge of bar pricing is weak. Accommodation is the most variable, because El Nido prices swing widely by season, location and venue. July falls in the southwest monsoon, so demand is typically lower than peak season, and prices may sit toward the lower end of the range. FX is the RBA AUD/USD observation for 15 October 2026 (4.00 pm), taken from the RBA exchange rates overview page surfaced by search.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: Philippine island tourist towns, using Puerto Princesa and Coron on Palawan as the baseline for local prices. El Nido is adjusted upward for its premium tourist demand and remote-island supply costs, most visibly in accommodation and drinks.
